review_scope: Read-only local source metadata. No authentic score table, neural array, source model, evaluator, test, network request or shared repository mutation.

examples.independent_unit: Participant, pending recording identity join; not a participant-condition row or a time sample.

required_support_per_group.support_kind: Released numeric table identifiers; mapping to original recordings is unrecovered.

metric.name: Pearson correlation r of reconstructed ECG
metric.source_definition: Backward EEG/MEG model .r per participant and ICA condition; the original partition-to-.r reduction remains unresolved.

published_vector_source.name: dec_r_ecg.csv
published_vector_source.role: Recovered public author scores; not decoder input recordings or candidate ground-truth labels.

examples.source_summary_semantics: All120 score rows form six participant vectors. Importer means/SD are descriptive and do not establish the original reported group statistic, contrast, confidence interval or executable comparison endpoint.

candidate_comparison_policy.role_of120_rows: Mandatory cohort/audit/paired-uncertainty support, not120 improvement targets.
candidate_comparison_policy.required_default: Recover and compare the exact original author-reported group statistics or contrasts and reduction; keep complete original participant support.

examples.required_original_protocol: 20-person simultaneous Salzburg M/EEG/ECG cohort, original modality channels and ECG-informed ICA, 100-Hz sampling, four-fold nested temporal CV, -250 to250-ms integration window and50-ms Hamming basis. Preserve all six conditions and preprocessing ECG exposure.
blocking_issues: The exact original group statistic or contrast defining improvement is unresolved. Neither120 pointwise score objectives nor an automatic six-group Pareto rule is adopted.
Join numeric released IDs to immutable original recordings/channels and authenticate the exact CSV exporter.
Recover original temporal fold identities, artifact exclusions and partition-to-r aggregation.
Resolve plain versus filter/threshold-suffixed source filenames and historical library/environment parity.
Qualify native author replay and strongest relevant comparator, source-based reproduction tolerances, meaningful gain and paired six-group inference.
An additive selected-endpoint scope and prospective comparison policy need explicit adoption; old age/slope biological reproduction remains separate.

examples.paper_locator: Original NEDS Table1 and AppendixE Table10
examples.complete_source_support: All74 source pretraining sessions and10 source held-out sessions; original70/10/20 target-session training/validation/test trial protocol. The published summaries concern ten held-out animals/sessions after source-permitted fine-tuning.
examples.independent_unit: Held-out animal after authenticated EID/probe/animal join. Ten session summaries are not automatically ten independent animals; neurons/trials/time bins are nested observations.
examples.known_anchor_qualification: These are rounded published NEDS summary anchors copied from already reviewed local metadata. They are neither new author reruns nor a fully authenticated strongest-comparator vector. Decoding SEMs and alternative-model values are not supplied by the inspected metadata snippets and remain null rather than guessed.
examples.metric_definition: Each encoding coordinate is the source per-neuron Poisson log-likelihood gain over that neuron's evaluation-mean-null divided by total spikes and ln2; average defined neurons within each session, then retain the original ten-session summary. Choice/block use ordinary accuracy. Wheel/whisker R2 flattens all evaluated trials/time, without clipping negative values.
examples.source_zero_and_undefined_behavior: Zero predicted/null rates map to1e-9 in source; source zero-spike/undefined-neuron behavior and any changed complete-population rejection rule require explicit parity qualification.

strongest_comparator.reason: Table10 includes RRR,NDT2,POYO+ decoding references; no encoding results for those decoder comparators. Do not invent absent model-by-endpoint cells or assume NEDS is strongest in every metric. Exact comparable source models and matched author rerun must be bound per endpoint.

forbidden_substitutions: No average of bits/spike, accuracy andR2, no win-count score and no dropping a regressing endpoint.
Published SEM or printing precision is not a reproduction tolerance or meaningful-effect threshold.
No train-only local ridge as NEDS, source RRR or strongest source baseline.
No same-architecture or equal-compute causal pretraining claim from absolute Table1/Table10 scores.
No source Figure2 annotation reconstructed as percentage change of unrelated table means.
blocking_issues: Authenticate original ONE object versions, eligible units/trials and actual74/10-session data lineage.
Resolve paper2-Hz versus code>5-Hz neuron filtering, presplit scaling, list-valued validity-mask behavior and camera lineage against original results.
Recover original ordered eligibility-dependent70/10/20 partitions and process-wide seed42/RNG history.
Qualify full-trial native author execution, training masks/checkpoints and matched resource/exposure conditions.
Bind all nine endpoint source comparators, justified reproduction tolerances, meaningful gains and selection-aware paired animal-level inference.
Explicitly adopt the selected Table1/Table10 primary as an additive version; broader Figure2 training/transfer findings remain separate reproduction.
